name: Productivity Directory

sources.title: Submit page — requires Google sign-in ('free and only takes a few seconds')

requirements: Product should fit the productivity taxonomy (to-do, time tracking, notes, calendar, automation, password managers, AI tools, etc.)
Google sign-in required to submit — 'To prevent spam, some actions require being signed in. It's free and only takes a few seconds.'
preparation: Tool name, URL, description, logo, and best-fit category from their ~50-category taxonomy
workflow: Complete the listing form shown after sign-in
Submit and await listing; manage it later from the user dashboard (/user/dash)
watchFor: The submit URL renders only the sign-in wall to anonymous visitors — no public form fields are visible
An Advertise page exists separately; organic listing is positioned as free
No evidence of a paid listing tier, but none is explicitly ruled out either
countsAsLive: Tool page exists on productivity.directory under its category (e.g. /category/note-taking-apps) and is publicly reachable
unknowns: Post-login form fields and whether any payment step follows
Dofollow vs nofollow on outbound links
